claims.text: Adding `render :show` to the shared `perform_show_response` method (needed only so the new unsubscribe action has a template) changes the render timing of the existing `topics#show` action and causes its canonical link tag to disappear.

topicUnsubscribe is declared as a top-level route, but the template lives at templates/topic/unsubscribe.hbs (which resolves to topic.unsubscribe), so Ember may not find/render the intended template and the unsubscribe page may render incorrectly or blank

The unsubscribe action requires ensure_logged_in but the unsubscribe URL is embedded in notification emails - when logged-out users click the link, they are silently redirected to the homepage with no error message and no unsubscribe action taken, making the per-topic email unsubscribe feature non-functional for the most common use case
After dropdown-button was changed to omit the `<h4 class='title'>` element entirely when title is empty, does this cause any layout shift for existing users of the notifications/pinned buttons?
Duplicate respond instructions in email template - Line 6 duplicates the respond instructions that already appear at Line 19 when context_posts are present
Rendering {{title}} inside HTML translation creates an XSS vulnerability on the unsubscribe page because the title is interpolated and inserted with triple-stash without escaping
Missing trailing comma in multiline filter list - the array passed to skip_before_filter should include a trailing comma after :unsubscribe to match project style and fix lint warning
The unsubscribe redirect uses a permanent 301 status and doesn't reuse the existing `redirect_to_correct_topic` helper's handling of JSON-format requests.

The new controller action, model method, and two new routes have zero test coverage; the only touched spec merely adds a now-required parameter without asserting anything about the new unsubscribe link or behavior.

The first click only downgrades the notification level to 'regular' (replies and mentions still notify), which contradicts both the email copy and the confirmation-page copy that promise notifications will 'stop'.

The unsubscribe write bypasses `TopicUser.change` and saves directly, leaving `notifications_reason_id` blank; as a result the unsubscribe action gets silently auto-reverted later by `update_last_read`/`TrackedTopicsUpdater` and never broadcasts the change via MessageBus to other open tabs.

The new per-topic unsubscribe endpoint is a GET request that has a state-changing side effect (writes notification_level), giving it no CSRF protection and making it triggerable by mail-client link prefetching or a forged `` tag pointing at it.

Template is named for a nested topic.unsubscribe route, but the router/controller/view use the top-level topicUnsubscribe route, so the new page content will not be picked up unless the template is renamed to match that route
Header class has leading dot preventing CSS targeting - Line 10 includes '.previous-discussion' instead of 'previous-discussion' in the class attribute

The unsubscribe link requires the user to be logged in and silently redirects unauthenticated visitors to the homepage with no message or return URL; it also doesn't reuse the repo's existing signed-key unsubscribe mechanism used elsewhere for email links.

The unsubscribe_link i18n string now requires %{unsubscribe_url} interpolation but Email::MessageBuilder provides no default value for it - any plugin using build_email with add_unsubscribe_link: true without providing unsubscribe_url will raise I18n::MissingInterpolationArgument
Test for List-Unsubscribe header only checks presence but should assert the value uses the provided unsubscribe_url
Does `add_unsubscribe_link: true` now implicitly require also passing `unsubscribe_url`, and should this new calling contract have an explicit guard against missing it?

GET request performs a state-mutating action - Both unsubscribe routes are GET but the controller action immediately writes to the database on every visit, allowing email security scanners and link-prefetching services to silently change notification levels without user intent
logic: Potential nil pointer exception - if no TopicUser record exists, tu will be nil and calling methods on it will crash

The Ember `topicUnsubscribe` route unconditionally displays a 'notifications stopped' message even when reached via a client-side transition, in which case the server unsubscribe endpoint is never actually called.
State-changing unsubscribe action uses GET request - topics#unsubscribe mutates notification state but is mapped to GET, should use POST/PUT or require a signed token
List-Unsubscribe header omits the new per-topic URL - The header still only advertises user_preferences_url instead of including the new per-topic unsubscribe URL
Typo in property name: 'stopNotificiationsText' should be 'stopNotificationsText' (missing 'n' in 'Notifications')
